quotes.speaker: Zaire
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Durant's legacy needs another championship more than Giannis Antetokounmpo's
quotes.excerpt: I think it probably mean a little more for Kevin Durant than it would Giannis Antetokounmpo.
quotes.quote: I think it probably mean a little more for Kevin Durant than it would Giannis Antetokounmpo. Because people always say Kevin Durant got his rings from Warriors, Steph and all that shit, which I don't believe that's the case, but it'd be cool to see him get one in Houston. Giannis, it don't really matter.
quotes.social_post: Zaire argues that a championship would mean more for Kevin Durant than Giannis Antetokounmpo because people still hold the Warriors rings against KD. Do you agree that KD needs a ring outside of Golden State to solidify his legacy?

quotes.speaker: Jeff Teague
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green and Eddie Johnson's public argument over Steph Curry
quotes.excerpt: He said Draymond Green can't score when Stephen Curry don't play.

text_blocks.speaker: Jeff Teague
text_blocks.text: What the hell is Draymond Green arguing with him for? Because he said Draymond Green can't score when Stephen Curry don't play. So he kind of started it.

text_blocks.speaker: Mook
text_blocks.text: Oh, he started it with my boy.

text_blocks.speaker: Jeff Teague
text_blocks.text: He was like, you know you talk about me being a broadcaster now, he said but when Stephen Curry don't play, that's all you do.

quotes.social_post: Jeff Teague weighs in on the Draymond Green and Eddie Johnson beef. Teague says Eddie Johnson was cold and points out that Johnson started it by claiming Draymond cannot score when Steph Curry is not on the floor.

quotes.speaker: Jeff Teague
quotes.summary_phrase: Eddie Johnson's claim about his own scoring ability in his rookie season
quotes.excerpt: He said I had 43 and a half, ask your coach, he was my rookie.
quotes.quote: He said I had 43 and a half, ask your coach, he was my rookie. He was killing. He said I scored 19,000 points, bro. He ain't no slouch.
quotes.social_post: Jeff Teague gives respect to Eddie Johnson, reminding everyone that Johnson scored 19,000 points in his career. He says Johnson was killing it as a rookie and is no slouch.
